title: DOW-UAP-D19, Mission Report, Syria, February 21, 2023
doc_notes: This is a declassified U.S. Air Force mission report (MISREP) from February 2023 containing a report of an aerial encounter with unidentified objects.

encounters.summary: Aircrew observed three possible UAP while cruising in CAP; no radar returns were received, but the objects were IR significant.
